_comment: Measured test seconds for CI's test shards (scripts/ci_test_shards.py): `modules` is each module's whole Test/test, `split` the suites of a module spread over the shards. A suite of a split module not named here shares what is left of its module's seconds with the other unnamed ones. Measured on ubuntu-24.04 runners, the mean of three green runs of `check` on main (2026-11-14, Scala tests and native guards jobs 132485824483, 132505930669 and 132513917156), each suite's time from the sbt log: tests run one suite at a time (build.sbt, `Test / parallelExecution`), and sbt writes a suite's lines when it ends.
